name: meeting-finder
description: Find explainable meeting times across a shared audience.

scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run start -- serve
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run build:site && bun --bun vitest run
scripts.lint:boundaries: bunx --no-install --bun fallow architecture --fail-on-issues && bunx --no-install --bun fallow dead-code --unresolved-imports --fail-on-issues
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run lint:boundaries && bun run typecheck && bun run effect:diagnostics && bun run test
